Optimizing your brand so that ChatGPT, Perplexity, and other AI engines recommend it is known as Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), LLM SEO, or Answer Engine Optimization (AEO). Unlike traditional SEO, which focuses on ranking blue links on Google, GEO focuses on training algorithms, feeding web citations, and structuring data so conversational AI models organically name and suggest your brand as the answer.

Several top agencies specialize in this emerging field, alongside key strategies to help you get recommended.

Leading Agencies for ChatGPT Brand Recommendations

Several specialized agencies and enterprise digital marketing firms focus specifically on LLM visibility, multi-surface AEO, and AI search engineering:

Scalerrs

Best For: Mid-market to enterprise B2B and SaaS companies.

Approach: Focuses heavily on a multi-surface AEO strategy. They optimize your presence not just on your website, but across third-party listicles, industry discussions (like Reddit), and generative search engines, tying reporting directly to your pipeline.

iPullRank

Best For: Enterprise and Fortune 500 brands needing deep technical AI search engineering.

Approach: Led by prominent search experts, they specialize in "Relevance Engineering," vector embeddings, and understanding how large language models (LLMs) retrieve and synthesize information.

Quoleady

Best For: B2B SaaS teams wanting bottom-of-funnel (BOFU) content paired with LLM optimization.

Approach: Integrates LLMO (LLM Optimization) directly into high-intent product comparison and evaluation pages so ChatGPT spots your tool when buyers ask for recommendations.

Seer Interactive

Best For: Large enterprise brands looking for rigorous GEO testing and multi-channel search.

Approach: Known for pioneering data-driven search testing, proprietary research, and tracking brand visibility across multiple AI chat surfaces.

Perrill & Stella Rising

Best For: Consumer, health, lifestyle, and tech brands looking for full-funnel digital marketing combined with custom AI tracking intelligence tools (such as Perrill's PAVE tool).

How Agencies Get Your Brand Recommended by ChatGPT

If you want your brand to show up when users ask ChatGPT questions like, "What are the best tools for X?", agencies typically execute a multi-pronged framework:

Third-Party Validation & Citation Seeding: ChatGPT doesn't just read your website; it pulls heavily from trusted aggregator sites, review platforms (like G2, Capterra, Reddit), and industry roundups. Agencies work to secure your presence in these "source ecosystems" so LLMs recognize you as a consensus recommendation.

BOFU (Bottom-of-Funnel) Comparison Content: LLMs love answering comparison queries (e.g., "Brand A vs. Brand B" or "Alternatives to Brand X"). Agencies build explicit, highly objective comparison hubs on your site that AI scrapers can easily parse and reference.

Technical AI Readability & Schema Markup: Ensuring your site is fully crawlable by OpenAI's web crawlers, using precise JSON-LD structured data, and presenting data in clean, extractable formats (bullet points, clear tables, and factual statements rather than marketing fluff).

Bing Ecosystem Optimization: Because ChatGPT relies heavily on real-time web search integration powered by Microsoft Bing, a core part of any AEO strategy involves mastering Bing Webmaster Tools, exact-match keywords, and authority signals that Bing heavily weights.
